Correctly invariant to global gain and responsive to independent speech and pause level changes, with strong persistence (Spearman 0.71; ICC 0.66). It is not physical SNR and is strongly anticorrelated with pause level (Spearman -0.919); it must not be treated as independent additive-noise evidence or used in an acquisition-only composite.

Detects controlled 50/60-Hz harmonic combs and rejects prespecified colored-noise, off-grid, single-tone, breath-like, and competing-speech controls. Only 41.0% of recordings have sufficient support; 11/213 eligible recordings exceed the count-matched null with >=3 supported harmonics. Low repeat persistence is not interpreted as estimator failure because hum-like interference can be intermittent. Exact low-F0 periodic sources remain an irreducible confound.
